Soniya gandhi ki kitab Belonging: A Journey of Love men bihar ke mukhyamantri nitish kumar ka bhi jikr hai. aakhir soniya gandhi ne nitish kumar ke bare men kya likha aur unke sath apne rajnitik rishton ko kis najrie se dekha? is riport men janie kitab men darj nitish kumar se juri khas baten aur iske siyasi mayne.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
